messages:
marco: Quick task  refreshing the Quickstart sample page. Two parts: (1) swap auth examples to the token env var, (2) add a README docs-badge that links to the live quickstart so users can jump straight to examples.

selina: I can update the auth lines. Which env var name are we standardizing on?

marco: REDWOOD_TOKEN everywhere (replace REDWOOD_API_KEY). Show both export and .env examples. Also we should include a tiny migration note: how to create a demo token via CLI.

dev-qa: I'll add a short smoke-test script that runs the sample and verifies a 200 from the /health and that a minimal generate call returns JSON. We can use it in CI to keep the badge accurate.

marco: Nice. Keep the smoke-test tiny so it runs in <=30s. Example curl sequence in the docs would be useful too.

selina: Dockerfile for the sample app (node) I'll include in the repo so badge CI can build it quickly:
```
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","index.js"]
```

dev-qa: For the smoke test I'll do: 
```
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=demo-token-for-ci
# start server in background then:
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" http://localhost:8080/generate | jq . || exit 1
```
Make sure the sample app masks tokens in logs in CI.

marco: Also add a tiny section in Quickstart about not committing tokens and how to use a .env file for local dev.

selina: I'll push docs changes + sample app tweak. Want the README badge to show "quickstart: passing/failed" based on smoke-test. Any badge provider preference?

dev-qa: We can use our internal docs CI that already supports status badges. I'll wire the smoke-test into the docs pipeline and export a badge URL.

marco: Cool. Please also include a Cloud Run snippet (env var example) so deploy docs match quickstart. One-liner is fine.

selina: Cloud Run example: `gcloud run deploy quickstart --image gcr.io/$PROJECT/quickstart --set-env-vars REDWOOD_TOKEN=$REDWOOD_TOKEN --platform managed --region us-central1`

dev-qa: I'll create a tiny CI job that builds the Dockerfile, runs the smoke-test, and updates the badge. Will keep logs gated behind docs CI.

selina: Opening PR now with docs + Dockerfile + Cloud Run snippet + small migration blurb. Assigning @marco and @dev-qa for review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5007

preview-bot: Preview built: https://deploy-preview-5007--docs.redwood.ai (live for 15m)

marco: Thanks. I'll run the preview locally and verify the smoke-test passes against the sample app. If green, merge before the docs sync.

dev-qa: I'll follow up once the CI badge is wired and post the badge URL in the PR comments. :thumbsup:
